title: Good intentions but there is upkeep
text: Good intentions but there is upkeep. Works very well to block fluid and keep the mattress dry but maintenance is more than I care to do.  Had to wring it, essentially, and wash it in special detergent (made for babies' laundry) to get it fresh enough to suit me.  Also, as soon as it gets more than a spot on it, it must be changed and that is a lot to do every time this happens.  Not really convenient for a caregiver- disposable pads or even washable reusable pads seem to better meet this need in my opinion.  Also, the material is very thin and fits deeper mattresses poorly.
